# Gleipnir

> Gleipnir (getgleipnir.com) films skilled people from their own eyes while they do their real jobs, and sells the footage as training data for robots and physical AI. Slogan: "Robots learn real work from real workers." Based in Vienna, Austria; films in Central Europe, starting with professional electricians in Slovakia.

## What we offer
- First-person (egocentric) video of real, paid work. Not staged; mistakes and rework included.
- Today: electricians. Tasks: pulling cable, wall chasing, setting boxes, stripping and preparing wires, connecting terminals, mounting sockets and switches, installing lights, wiring panels, testing and fault finding. More people, trades and workplaces are being added.
- Capture: head-mounted camera, 4K 3840x2880, 4:3, 30 fps, both hands in frame.
- Delivery: full sessions plus per-task clips with start and end times, a JSON card per clip (task, duration, hands, rework). MP4 (HEVC) by default.
- Privacy and consent: written release from every worker for every session; every worker is paid for every recorded hour; faces and readable text blurred; audio removed.
- Quality: every clip is reviewed for blur, focus and hands in frame.
- Capacity today: about 12 usable hours per week.

## Pricing
- Free sample.
- Non-exclusive commercial training licence from $25 per hour of footage that passes our checks; cheaper above 100 hours.
- Exclusive sets, recording to a buyer's task list, other trades, stereo cameras and extra sensors: on request.

## How to get a sample
- Email for a sample: ivan.voloshyn@getgleipnir.com

## Roadmap
Now: trade footage sold by the hour. Next: more workers and trades, stereo camera with IMU, recording to spec, 100 hours on hand. Then: testing robots on the tasks we film with the businesses that let us in. Goal: a robot for one skilled task.

## Contact
Ivan Voloshyn, founder. ivan.voloshyn@getgleipnir.com

Not to be confused with the Gleipnir desktop app for running AI coding agents (gleipnir.app), which is a separate, unrelated product. Gleipnir's earlier project on signed mandates for AI agents is archived at https://getgleipnir.com/mandates.
